meta.note: The vocabulary songs are made of — fado from Lisbon, bailinho and despique from Madeira. Words only, with examples written for this deck: no lyrics are quoted anywhere, because living songwriters own their lines. The genre's stock of images (o cais, a gaivota, o luar, o xaile) is nobody's property, and it is exactly what you need to follow a casa de fado night or an arraial.

cards.note: the genre AND destiny itself — the double meaning is the whole point
cards.ex_t: O fado canta o que a vida faz às pessoas.
cards.ex_trans: Fado sings what life does to people.

cards.note: cantar com alma — to sing with soul
cards.ex_t: Ela canta com uma alma que arrepia.
cards.ex_trans: She sings with a soul that gives you chills.

cards.note: fado's favourite subject after saudade
cards.ex_t: Contra o destino não vale a pena lutar, diz o fado.
cards.ex_trans: Against fate there's no point fighting, says fado.

cards.note: the pear-shaped twelve-string — not a Spanish guitar
cards.ex_t: A guitarra portuguesa chora antes de a fadista abrir a boca.
cards.ex_trans: The Portuguese guitar weeps before the fado singer opens her mouth.

cards.note: in fado, viola means the regular guitar; viola de arame on Madeira
cards.ex_t: A viola marca o ritmo, a guitarra faz o resto.
cards.ex_trans: The viola keeps the rhythm, the guitarra does the rest.

cards.note: a fadista — the female singer, the genre's centre of gravity
cards.ex_t: A fadista fecha os olhos quando canta.
cards.ex_trans: The fado singer closes her eyes when she sings.

cards.note: the black shawl — fado's visual signature since Severa
cards.ex_t: De xaile preto, ela parecia saída de um retrato antigo.
cards.ex_trans: In a black shawl she looked straight out of an old portrait.

cards.note: dinner, candles, silence when the lights dim
cards.ex_t: Na casa de fados pede-se silêncio quando começa o fado.
cards.ex_trans: In a fado house silence is asked for when the fado begins.

cards.note: a whole word for it — songs would collapse without it
cards.ex_t: O largo ficava bonito ao luar.
cards.ex_trans: The square looked beautiful in the moonlight.

cards.ex_t: Uma lágrima no fim da canção não envergonha ninguém.
cards.ex_trans: A tear at the end of the song shames nobody.

cards.note: dizer adeus — heavier than até logo
cards.ex_t: As canções de emigração são todas sobre o adeus.
cards.ex_trans: Emigration songs are all about farewell.

cards.note: where fado's goodbyes happen; plural is also cais
cards.ex_t: No cais, metade da ilha despediu-se de alguém.
cards.ex_trans: On the quay, half the island said goodbye to someone.

cards.note: the bird fado sent into every harbour song
cards.ex_t: As gaivotas seguem os barcos até à barra.
cards.ex_trans: The seagulls follow the boats out to the harbour mouth.

cards.ex_t: O marinheiro promete voltar; a canção sabe que não.
cards.ex_trans: The sailor promises to return; the song knows better.

cards.note: Alfama, Mouraria — fado names its bairros like family
cards.ex_t: Cada bairro de Lisboa tem o seu fado.
cards.ex_trans: Every Lisbon neighbourhood has its own fado.

cards.ex_t: A voz vinha de uma viela escura da Alfama.
cards.ex_trans: The voice came from a dark Alfama alley.

cards.note: partir o coração — to break someone's heart
cards.ex_t: Meio cancioneiro português é coração partido.
cards.ex_trans: Half the Portuguese songbook is broken hearts.

cards.note: the working construction of the untranslatable word
cards.ex_t: Tenho saudades das noites de agosto na vila.
cards.ex_trans: I miss the August nights in the village.

cards.note: when fado protagonists do their best suffering
cards.ex_t: Voltou para casa pela madrugada fria.
cards.ex_trans: He walked home through the cold small hours.

cards.note: THE Madeira folk genre — accordion, brinquinho, spinning couples
cards.ex_t: No arraial, o bailinho junta toda a gente.
cards.ex_trans: At the festival, the bailinho gathers everyone.

cards.note: two singers improvise verses at each other until one runs dry
cards.ex_t: No despique ganha quem tiver a rima mais rápida.
cards.ex_trans: In a despique the fastest rhyme wins.

cards.note: dolls in folk dress on a stick, castanets on their backs — really
cards.ex_t: O brinquinho sobe e desce ao ritmo do bailinho.
cards.ex_trans: The brinquinho pumps up and down to the bailinho's beat.

cards.ex_t: Sem acordeão não há arraial que se aguente.
cards.ex_trans: Without an accordion no festival holds up.

cards.note: espetada smoke, wine, bailinho — the Madeira summer
cards.ex_t: O arraial do Monte é o maior da ilha.
cards.ex_trans: The Monte festival is the island's biggest.

cards.ex_t: A romaria acaba em música, como deve ser.
cards.ex_trans: The pilgrimage ends in music, as it should.

cards.note: four seven-syllable lines — the atom of Portuguese folk song, anonymous and free
cards.ex_t: Cada terra tem quadras próprias, passadas de boca em boca.
cards.ex_trans: Every village has its own quatrains, passed mouth to mouth.

cards.note: the mainland cousin of the despique
cards.ex_t: No fim da festa cantaram à desgarrada até de manhã.
cards.ex_trans: At the end of the party they sang improvised verses till morning.

cards.note: a letra da canção — the words of the song
cards.ex_t: A melodia é alegre, mas repara na letra.
cards.ex_trans: The melody is cheerful — but look at the lyrics.

cards.ex_t: Fixei a melodia à primeira, a letra é que custa.
cards.ex_trans: I caught the melody first time — it's the words that are hard.

cards.ex_t: Ela sobe ao palco como quem entra em casa.
cards.ex_trans: She takes the stage like someone walking into their own home.

cards.ex_t: A plateia nem respirava durante o fado.
cards.ex_trans: The audience didn't even breathe during the fado.

cards.note: 'silêncio, que se vai cantar o fado' — the traditional call
cards.ex_t: Pediram silêncio e apagaram-se as luzes.
cards.ex_trans: They asked for silence and the lights went down.

cards.note: fica arrepiado — covered in goosebumps; high praise for a singer
cards.ex_t: Aquela voz arrepia qualquer um.
cards.ex_trans: That voice gives anyone goosebumps.

cards.note: the Madeira century in one verb — half the songbook comes from it
cards.ex_t: Meia freguesia emigrou para a Venezuela nos anos sessenta.
cards.ex_trans: Half the parish emigrated to Venezuela in the sixties.

cards.note: a minha terra — the emigrant's two-word biography
cards.ex_t: Nas festas canta-se sempre à terra natal.
cards.ex_trans: At festivals people always sing to the homeland.
